name: YiwuGo (Yiwu Market Direct)
description: Direct digital window to Yiwu International Trade City: 75,000+ booths for small commodities and daily accessories.
fullDescription: YiwuGo is the official online gateway to Yiwu International Trade City, the world’s largest wholesale market for small commodities. With 360-degree panoramic virtual storefronts for 75,000 physical stalls, it is the premier platform for sourcing jewelry, toys, hardware, holiday decor, and stationery.
features: Digital showcase of 75,000+ physical vendor booths in Yiwu Trade City
Direct contact with stall owners via live chat and WeChat translation
Extremely low minimum order quantities on fast-moving consumer goods
360-degree virtual reality market map and booth location directories
Buyer protection services and local inspection assistance programs
